scope: Existing user journeys and required completion behavior; feature existence is not a pass.
snapshot: All completed correction reports through navigation, including the read-only Working rename clarification, are reconciled. Four parent-adopted quality-correction records map into existing journeys. Forms valid input, blank paging and Working rename commit remain inconclusive within their stated cases; no complete workflow is certified.
verdict: Incomplete runtime coverage; no whole-journey production-quality pass is claimed.

status_meanings.not-exercised: Related source risks exist, but this complete journey has not been exercised in runtime evidence read for this matrix.
status_meanings.partial-runtime-failure: At least one executed branch fails; remaining branches are unverified.
status_meanings.positive-runtime-branch-only: A bounded success exists; the complete journey is not certified.
status_meanings.runtime-inconclusive: Runtime was attempted but the intended input/rendering boundary was not established; this is neither a certified product failure nor a complete pass.

cases.journey: Open the PR the user clicked
cases.trigger: Keep thread A focused, hide the right panel, and click the PR badge on thread B; repeat through footer, Overview and context menu.
cases.intended_visible_outcome: B’s PR is visible in the intended native destination; the selected thread, PR identity and copied URL agree.
cases.failure_recovery: Missing URL, unavailable browser ownership or PR read failure produces a visible explanation on the user’s current surface.
cases.cross_surface_checks: Repeat with another project filter, open Browser and a second PR target; preserve A’s unsent draft.
cases.next_runtime_check: Test cross-thread navigation from absent/empty board and remaining entry points; require the clicked target visibly appear while preserving the prior draft.
cases.evidence_basis: Bounded observed branches with stated limits; no complete journey certified
runtime_observations: Production gh discovery supplies A/#101 and B/#202. With A selected and panel hidden, an actual click on B’s badge leaves A selected and no visible panel; an OCR/element assertion fails in repeated runs.
A’s own badge opens Browser; Overview’s PR row opens native #101 with populated Summary and Timeline. The split destinations are directly observed.
remaining_unverified_branches: B absent from board/empty board, footer and external/modifier routes, CEF GitHub load, no-PR/missing-URL/error targeting and preservation of an unrelated draft were not exercised.

cases.journey: Refresh a PR and recover from failed reads
cases.trigger: Open PR details, change the fixture’s checks/comments, refresh, then inject an error and delayed old response.
cases.intended_visible_outcome: The visible current PR refreshes checks and comments together; a late response cannot replace a newer target.
cases.failure_recovery: Keep last useful content, show a scoped error, make Retry actually retry, and cancel or bound abandoned reads.
cases.cross_surface_checks: Switch PR/thread and close/reopen while a read is outstanding.
cases.next_runtime_check: Verify checks/body/comments always invalidate current detail and preserve visibly stale content during failures; then exercise concurrency/auth and action-driven refresh.
cases.evidence_basis: Bounded observed branches with stated limits; no complete journey certified
runtime_observations: Actual thread-menu Refresh and palette Refresh trigger one lightweight PR read but no detailed read when only checks/body/comments change. Native review remains stale while Overview reflects new CI.
Re-entering Overview’s PR row reloads details. A synthetic OPEN→MERGED change does trigger detailed refresh and new body/check/comment rendering. No forge write occurs.
remaining_unverified_branches: Auth expiry, transient failed reload retaining prior content, out-of-order reads/cancellation/deadline and agent-action refresh remain untested.
Initial synthetic-repository read error was clipped in the panel, but the fixture caused the error; native network/auth recovery is not established.

remaining_unverified_branches: Guide generation, Code/review interaction, full replies/verdicts, long data caps, check-detail navigation, description formatting and sync context remain unverified.

Working and settled row actions display a rename hint. For Working, the specific rename-thread-2 selector was absent; type/Enter acknowledged input but the full editor text/commit was not established. An immediate title read had no settle interval or later persistence check. This is inconclusive, not a saved-rename failure. Settled typing/save was not completed.

Working input/commit and settled rename save remain unresolved. Normal rename Cancel, failed reopen, grouped Undo Park, bulk failure and Cmd+W remain unverified.
